children: The IPO comprises a fresh issue of Rs 360.75 crore and an offer for sale of Rs 140 crore

SS Retail, a multi-brand retailer of mobile phones, accessories and other electronic products, will open its Rs 500 crore initial public offering (IPO) for subscription on Wednesday, with the company having raised Rs 146.4 crore from institutional investors ahead of the issue.

The IPO will remain open until September 18, with the company having allotted 34.52 lakh shares to 14 anchor investors at Rs 424 apiece, the upper end of its price band. Domestic mutual funds accounted for 83.14 per cent of the anchor allocation, with 28.70 lakh shares allotted across 19 schemes.

SBI Mutual Fund, Kotak Mahindra Asset Management, ICICI Prudential Asset Management, Axis Mutual Fund, WhiteOak Capital, Motilal Oswal Asset Management, Invesco and Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management were among the domestic institutions participating in the anchor book. Bengal Finance and Investment, backed by investor Ashish Kacholia, Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance and 360 ONE were also among the investors.

SS Retail has fixed the price band at Rs 403-424 per share, valuing the company at around Rs 3,154 crore at the upper end. The IPO comprises a fresh issue of Rs 360.75 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of Rs 140 crore.

The company plans to deploy Rs 241.3 crore of the fresh issue proceeds towards incremental working capital requirements and Rs 12.4 crore towards establishing new stores during FY27 and FY28. The balance will be used for general corporate purposes.
The issue has a lot size of 35 shares, requiring retail investors to invest a minimum of Rs 14,840 at the upper end of the price band.

In the grey market, SS Retail shares were commanding a premium of around Rs 128 over the upper end of the IPO price band ahead of the issue, implying an unofficial premium of roughly 30 per cent. Grey market premiums, however, are unofficial and can change rapidly, and do not guarantee the price at which a stock will list.

SS Retail operates a multi-brand retail network focused on mobile phones and accessories across Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Goa and Gujarat. It had 503 stores across 215 cities as of March 2026, including 458 stores in Maharashtra. The company has since expanded its network to 536 stores as of July 2026.
The company primarily targets tier-II, tier-III and smaller cities and describes itself as the largest mobile phone retail chain in West India and the third-largest among its Indian peers.
SS Retail reported consolidated revenue of Rs 2,351 crore and profit of Rs 59.2 crore for FY26. Its revenue rose from Rs 1,597.9 crore in FY25, while profit increased from Rs 39.86 crore.
The company competes with listed retailers including Aditya Vision, Electronics Mart India, Jay Jalaram Technologies, Fonebox Retail and Umiya Mobile.

The IPO’s share allotment is expected to be finalised on September 21, with the shares scheduled to list on the bourses on September 23. Anand Rathi Advisors and Emkay Global Financial Services are the book-running lead managers for the issue.
